programs.escrowProgramIdNote: PLACEHOLDER — no mainnet deployment exists. This is the devnet legacy Anchor program id and MUST be replaced (and this note removed) before any mainnet activation. See docs/SOLANA-EXTERNAL-AUDIT-HANDOFF-2026-06-24.md: mainnet is gated on external audit.
programs.registryProgramIdNote: No mainnet Quasar registry deployment is registered. Until one is, the resolver leaves this key unset and the blocked legacy-Anchor mainnet profile aliases the registry id to escrowProgramId above (the legacy Anchor program carries all instructions in one program).
programs.reputationProgramIdNote: No mainnet Quasar reputation deployment is registered. Until one is, the resolver leaves this key unset and the blocked legacy-Anchor mainnet profile aliases the reputation id to escrowProgramId above.
programs.attestationProgramIdNote: No mainnet Quasar attestation deployment is registered. Until one is, the resolver leaves this key unset and the blocked legacy-Anchor mainnet profile aliases the attestation id to escrowProgramId above.
programs.quasarProgramSetNote: The active devnet target is a four-program Quasar set. Mainnet remains disabled until audited mainnet ids for registry, escrow, reputation, and attestation are recorded and the resolver is deliberately enabled for that profile.
